statements: I read only the permitted inputs: tests/blind/cloud-holdout/cases.json, tests/blind/cloud-holdout/case-freeze.json, the four referenced PNG images (BH-027.png, BH-028.png, BH-029.png, BH-030.png), and tests/blind/GOLD_RUBRIC.md.
I did not read any runtime code, spec documents, public tests, mutation artifacts, plans, scorer code, history files, pull requests, other labelers' labels, or any model outputs.
I verified the SHA-256 of cases.json and of all four images against case-freeze.json before labeling; every hash matched.
I opened and inspected all four images and treated illegible or occluded regions as unrecoverable rather than guessing their content.
All labels were produced independently from the case material and the gold rubric only; no information was carried between cases.

I labeled all 30 cases and all 36 turns; turn_index values are 1-based; overall ratings follow the fixed Red > Gray > Yellow > Green derivation for rated routes, with null ratings only on the Message-template route.
